start.speaker: Elder Katsui of Vitengeni
start.text: Greetings, Mekatilili. Champion has sent armed askaris demanding three rupees for every hut in Vitengeni. If an elder cannot pay, they take his goats.

choices.text: A man does not pay rent to sleep in the hut his own hands built on ancestral land.
Drive the livestock into the sacred forest. Refuse the tax collector collectively.

node_pledge.speaker: Elder Katsui of Vitengeni
node_pledge.text: It shall be as you say! The council of Vitengeni unreservedly joins the boycott. No tax will leave our gates! Send word to Kaya Fungo!

events.value: The elders of Vitengeni have resolved to withhold all hut tax payments from colonial administrators.
